title: James McDonnell's search for 'gremlins' in his planes
summary: Jesse Michels tells of James McDonnell's search for 'gremlins' in his planes, about mid-20th century at McDonnell Douglas, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He would call them gremlins. And so he spent a lot of his research career looking for ghosts in the machine.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that James McDonnell, linked to the aircraft maker McDonnell Douglas, spoke of "gremlins" in his planes. According to Michels, he spent much of his research career looking for these ghosts in the machine, which hints that something strange was seen around aircraft.
